faq.q: Is the trial lesson really free?
faq.a: Yes. Your first lesson is free, with no card details and no obligation. If it isn't the right fit, you simply walk away.

faq.q: How do you choose my child's tutor?
faq.a: We don't leave it to chance or a search filter. Our team matches a tutor to the subject, the curriculum, your child's year and learning style, and your preferred times. If the fit isn't right, we'll switch tutors for free.
Lessons run live, one-to-one, by video call with a shared whiteboard. All you need is a laptop or tablet with a camera. Lessons are scheduled in your own timezone.

faq.q: Which subjects and curriculums do you cover?
faq.a: Maths, English and the sciences from Years 4–12, including NAPLAN, selective school preparation, HSC, VCE and ACT, plus IGCSE, GCSE, A-Level and IB.

faq.q: Can we cancel or reschedule a lesson?
faq.a: Yes. Reschedule or cancel with at least 24 hours' notice. There are no lock-in contracts.

faq.q: How will I know it's working?
faq.a: You'll get notes after every lesson and a written progress report every month showing strengths, gaps and the plan ahead.
